model: Pinned Qwen3.5-2B frozen features, CUDA-trained linear listwise head with abstention
split: EntityBindingFailures domain plus ambiguity families kept intact; five resolvable and one ambiguous family for training, one resolvable family for calibration, one resolvable and one ambiguous family for internal holdout
selection: Minimum calibration cross-entropy; neither the family holdout nor tau-bench selected the checkpoint
decision: Reject runtime promotion: severe cross-domain abstention and a wrong-target selection on previously inspected retail cases.
limitations: The entity source repeats a few templates, so even whole-family holdout is small and may share construction patterns. Both sources were inspected before this experiment; neither is a fresh blind test. Retail action annotations can depend on prior workflow steps. This is not Jev parity or execution authority.
